Jako osoba schorowana szczególnie doceniam jej troskę, zaangażowanie i indywidualne podejście do pacjenta. Zawsze mogę liczyć na pomoc, wsparcie i dokładne wyjaśnienie wszystkich kwestii związanych z leczeniem.
Dzięki Pani doktor czuję się naprawdę zaopiekowana i bezpieczna. As a patient myself, I particularly appreciate her care, commitment, and personalized approach to each patient. I can always count on her help, support, and thorough explanation of all treatment-related issues.
Thanks to her, I feel truly cared for and safe. I wholeheartedly recommend both the clinic and the doctor to anyone seeking professional and compassionate medical would like to thank the Staff at Rockfield Medical Centre for their kindness, care and compassion towards my mother Georgina. Special thanks to Dr Monika Tobolska and Dr Craig Wylie. Their professionalism, care, patience and understanding with each member of our family was exceptional and  greatly appreciated during a very difficult time. When you are feeling ill and vulnerable and can't get an appointment it is easy to criticise. I have been frustrated when all appointments are filled by 8.40am. You can't get through on the phone or a member of staff appears to be unhelpful. Please just stop and think. Do you really need the appointment, could you be seen somewhere else? Remember the reception team are doing their job and anyone of them may also be going through a hard time. Take a deep breath and speak kindly. Believe me when you are really ill they are wonderful.
This practice inherited a closed practice, they didn't have to do that, but I am truly glad they did!
